summary: Preview only: strict source/current-work gate refuses stale reassessment before grade, preferences, owner, writing or pending mutation. Original source remains frozen. Unmodified preview reproduces seven intended failures; repaired preview passes 15 native cases / 73 assertions, 105 preference cases and 23 identity cases.

source_copy.contents: 90 pinned JS/CJS, frozen case-report JSON, index.html and six referenced local PNG icons; raw copies only. No .git/.repowise/runtime/dependencies.

failing_labels.label: Deleted source must not replace current writing after held confirmation
Deleted source must not publish a stale reassessment owner
Deleted source must preserve current pending writing/photo result
Deleted source must preserve current grade and photo
Newly completed pending result must remain durable after an older confirmation
Newly completed result must retain its runtime owner and report
Newly completed result must keep its writing/owner until teacher reviews the changed context

behavior_and_review_requirements: Source binding: a recovery-aware strict raw portfolio read is validated/normalized once and supplies the selected session. The same raw bytes must still match after confirmation. No comparison of generated legacy IDs or stripped persistent identity fields.

Current-work snapshot is read-only at confirmation acceptance: DOM/runtime owner, writing, complete image queue including originalDataUrl/OCR properties, primary image, reassessment source, latest report/corrected data, genre, grade/override/neatness, stored settings/selection, actual runtime pending and persisted pending bytes. The existing opening pending hydration is retained for warning compatibility.

Pending bytes must parse and contain a named student plus object sessionData. Source/pending read, parse or unresolved recovery failures return before load mutations. The later image and missing-source replacement guards are untouched.

Reviewer041 projection checks every captured writing/owner/settings/grade/neatness/photo/source/runtime+stored-pending/report field on both original rejection paths, with portfolio/deletions compared against state immediately before acceptance; refusal status/focus/alerts may change.

Unchanged no-date stable-ID source has no pending result, holds the real modal across 20ms and loads normally with saved bytes unchanged. An id-less createdAt selector compatibility control also passes; it enters the public function directly because shipped rendering assigns generated IDs.

Same-ID source edit uses real savePortfolioLocalOnly persistence on the existing stored session, with an explicit one-session/no-duplicate premise. This is a controlled competing-save seam, not an additional claim of native user navigation.

Storage-only pending case updates persisted same-ID/signature payload in a second app tab through real pending persistence while the first tab caches the older runtime result. A premise asserts other stored inputs and cached runtime remain unchanged.

The original two risk cases retain genuine public reassessment/confirmation plus cross-tab delete and already-started analysis paths. Added photo mutation and read/parse failures are explicit synthetic boundary injections. All external origins are aborted; no live accounts or student data.
tradeoffs_and_limits: Conservative policy: any portfolio byte change, including an unrelated student save or equivalent serialization, requires a fresh action; stored settings changes also require retry. No automatic source refresh or global modal lock.

Freshness is a synchronous confirmation boundary, not a general cross-tab transaction. Existing post-load image/replacement guards still govern later changes. New recovery-failure branch is source-inspected; no dedicated recovery injection case was added.

No full gate, coverage import, health/index refresh, tracker/docs changes, Git mutation, deployment or integration. No real Drive/AI/OAuth testing. No duplicate existing-suite baseline run; their baseline is coordinator full004gate on exact frozen source.

A first preview used the impure context helper and failed one existing preference test; it was rejected. A read-only intermediate passed before strict raw-source/pending improvements. Final receipts all match the single final preview main hash; earlier attempt logs remain scratch evidence.

proposed_integration.now: None. Original repository/source freeze unchanged; await coordinator and two reviewers.
proposed_integration.tests: After integration authorization, adapt the standalone native driver into proposed tests/portfolio-reassessment.browser.cjs with normal repository report format; preserve these controls and strengthened oracles.
proposed_integration.manifest: No manifest change in this preview. If the coordinator adopts the new official case-report suite, add exactly that suite to scripts/case-report-suites.json after the freeze ends; do not register this scratch driver.
